description: This PHP file defines a migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 4.3.4. It contains logic to create a new database table 'ohrm_employee_subscription' if it does not already exist. The class extends an abstract migration class and implements methods to perform the migration and return the version.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class for updating the database schema to version 4.3.4, including creating the 'ohrm_employee_subscription' table.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the database migration, creates the 'ohrm_employee_subscription' table if it does not exist.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.3.4' indicating the migration version.
